transition_semantics: ordered phases; each condition enters its phase from the preceding phase; at most one transition per strictly increasing sample time
hold_semantics: numeric condition continuously true; invalid/missing data or excessive sample gap resets confirmation; event holds must be zero
action_semantics: requests only, explicitly simulated; no hardware command is sent and no completion is inferred
time: session MCU-monotonic microseconds; accepted START and physical launch are distinct events unless explicitly combined

trace.ordering: strictly increasing stage-entry times; each non-none action request immediately follows its entry at the same time; partial traces end between complete entry/action pairs
trace.validation_scope: structural reference records; not proof of input conditions, physical detection or hardware execution
